author: sjm41
body:
* **InterPro ID / label**
IPR011281 Succinate dehydrogenase, flavoprotein subunit

* **Example sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

* **Description of issue**
From the interpro description and associated proteins (or a least the reviewed UP entries), IPR011281 seems specific for the flavoprotein subunit of the SDH complex, which is called Sdh1 or SdhA depending on the organism.

Currently this entry has the high-level MF: [oxidoreductase activity, acting on the CH-CH group of donors (GO:0016627)](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/GTerm?id=GO:0016627)

I think  that MF could be replaced with this more specific, and recently created term:

id: GO:0160308
name: succinate dehydrogenase (FAD) activity
namespace: molecular_function
def: "Catalysis of the reaction: FAD + succinate + H+ = fumarate + FADH2." [RHEA:30343, WIKIPEDIA:SDHA]
xref: RHEA:30343 {source="skos:exactMatch"}
is_a: GO:0000104 ! succinate dehydrogenase activity


Also see previous discussion where this term was created in https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/30805

What do you think?
title: InterPro2GO issue: IPR011281 Succinate dehydrogenase, flavoprotein subunit

author: tony787
body:
Hi Steven,
Thank you for the suggestion. I have replaced the term with GO:0160308.
Changes will be visible in the next InterPro release.
Best wishes,
Toni

author: vanaukenk
source_title: New specific terms to represent the parts of succinate dehydrogenase performed by SDHA and SDHB

author: ValWood
body:
Hi @tony787 

After a long  discussion surrounding GOCAM modelling of this activity, we have decided  that it makes more sense to annotate all 4 subunits of  Complex II to 
GO:0008177    succinate dehydrogenase (quinone) activity, and we will obsolete the recently created 
GO:0160308 name: succinate dehydrogenase (FAD) activity

Apologies for the to-ing and fro-ing.

v

https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31897

author: tony787
body:
Dear Val,

Thank you for letting us know. 
I have replaced the term with GO:0008177 in IPR011281.
Changes will be visible in the next InterPro release.
Best wishes,
Toni
